capabilities: Render backgammon boards from XGID code blocks
Display eXtreme Gammon position analysis next to the board
Render cube analysis from pasted output
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no way to display backgammon positions or engine analysis in notes without pasting images.
summary: Code block renderer that draws backgammon boards and eXtreme Gammon analysis in notes from XGID strings.
